name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 12 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 12 hours starting 2025-08-06, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
